company.description: Worklytics is a tool that provides workforce analytics centered on productivity and collaboration. Worklytics is fully focused on improving the day-to-day work-life of employees using only anonymous work data. No creepy browser plugins or software monitoring people’s laptops.

productsAndServices.description: An analytics solution that connects to corporate AI tools to track AI adoption, usage patterns, and productivity impact across teams.

productsAndServices.description: A platform providing workflow and collaboration benchmarks across roles and industries to compare organizational work habits and performance metrics.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 81 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-11).
